about_the_game:
A retro psychological horror game that mixes the nostalgic 3rd person static camera of classic horror games and the terrifying first person camera used in modern horror games.

After Elliot comes into contact via walkie-talkie with a mysterious woman, he must search an abandoned coal mining distribution site to rescue her. While exploring the player uses a nostalgic retro third-person static camera.

But whenever the player ventures indoors the game will swap to a modern and more intense first person camera. The goal of this is to balance the eerie and stiff camera movement that made retro horror games so terrifying with the smoother camera and the pure immersion of modern horror game.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or equivalent (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3210 / AMD A8-7600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 (Proprietary drivers) / AMD Radeon HD 7850 (Mesa drivers) / Intel HD 520
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible or ALSA/PulseAudio (no dedicated sound card needed).
  • Additional Notes: Controller Recommended, system requirements subject to change.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2nd gen+) or Apple M1 (for ARM support, if applicable)

  • Graphics: Intel Iris 5100 / AMD Radeon R7 / Apple M1 (or equivalent)
